title: Oh No! ...Anyway
blurb: 'Oh no! ...Anyway.' — Jeremy Clarkson's masterclass in weaponized indifference. The two-second pivot from fake concern to total dismissal became the internet's favorite way to acknowledge a problem while refusing to care about it. Play it when bad news deserves a shrug: someone's crypto portfolio, the fifth meeting reschedule, consequences in general.
origin: Jeremy Clarkson's iconic dismissive pivot from The Grand Tour.
